"""A three-statement run repeated three times: period < window size.

The two windows that carry one segment hash OVERLAP (the second starts
inside the first), so ``merge_overlapping_items`` folds them into one span
and the emitted group reaches the document carrying a single item.
"""


def overlap_host(base: int) -> int:
    seed = [base, base]
    limit = len(seed) + 3
    scale = max(limit, 1)
    values = list(seed)
    count = len(values)
    width = count * 2
    acc = scale + 1
    if acc > 0:
        acc = acc - 1
    values.append(acc)
    acc = scale + 1
    if acc > 0:
        acc = acc - 1
    values.append(acc)
    acc = scale + 1
    if acc > 0:
        acc = acc - 1
    values.append(acc)
    return len(values) + count + width
